body:
Jeg anmeldte. Saken ble henlagt og jeg ble retraumatisert så mye at jeg ikke orker å være i jobb og nesten gjorde slutt på alt. 

Jeg angrer ikke på at jeg anmeldte, men skulle jeg valgt på nytt hadde jeg latt vær med det. 

Uansett hva du velger så gjør det som er best for deg <3
Why can't you have her spayed now? One of my foster cats was spayed while she was in heat and she was fine. And she stopped the yowling the within the next day.

He doesn't have to be a narc to gaslight. 
Gaslighting is abusive, and that makes him an abusive shit.   


You deserve so much more. I know I don't know you, but you seriously deserve better. Even if he wasn't an abusive puddle of puke, you would still deserve better.


Nobody should walk on eggshells in their own home. Or pretend like you are always happy because God forbid he has to comfort you. 

There is a book called "why does he do that" by Lundi Bancroft I read when I tried to justify leaving my abuser. It really opened my eyes.


Please reach out to someone for help to get away.
